Kiwanis Club of Boyne City

We serve Boyne City’s kids, and we have a blast doing it.

From the Turkey Trot to the Fourth of July games, we’re neighbors who show up for children in our community. Come see why our 7 a.m. meetings are the best hour of the week.

Come to a meeting See what we do

Our impact on local kids

Kiwanis clubs serve children, one child and one community at a time. Here in Boyne City, that means:

Reading and literacy

We back local reading programs and run the Eddie Essay contest, giving young writers a reason to find their voice.

Building self-worth

We support youth programs that help kids see what they’re capable of.

Stability and mental health

We help local organizations that support children facing instability and mental health challenges.

A year with the club

There’s always something happening, and kids are part of nearly all of it. Every dollar we raise stays in the Boyne City area.

  • Spring: Morel FestivalWe pitch in at one of Boyne City’s most beloved annual events.
  • July 4: Children’s gamesWe run the games, and the laughter is loud.
  • Labor Day weekend: Boyne City Car ShowClassic cars, big crowds, and funds that go back to local kids.
  • Thanksgiving morning: Turkey TrotA 5K and 1-mile fun run, now in its 16th year. The race shirt is designed by a Boyne City High School art student, and young people help with the whole event. We also collect canned goods for the local food pantry.
  • All school year: Eddie Essay and Trunk n ReadReading and writing programs at BC Elementary and beyond, plus family game days that anyone can drop by.

We also volunteer alongside other youth-focused organizations in the area, because kids do best when a whole community shows up.

Join us

You don’t need to be a Kiwanian yet. Just come say hello, have some coffee, and see what we’re about. No commitment, no pressure.
